propositions: Read-only derivations from gate sidecars compute LLM cost proxy and latency metrics by summing REVIEW_RESULT.metrics.llm_calls and latency fields across plan/code-review runs, with source=sidecar
Cost-per-accepted-change metric divides total llm_calls by count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records (accepted closes), returning None when zero accepted closes exist
First-pass verification metric calculates the fraction of tickets whose earliest COMPLETION_VERDICT record (by filename order) is a completion_verifier_pass_v1 PASS

Environment diagnosis interval metric pairs each gate_error_v1 ERROR record with the next PASS record for the same gate, matching on the ERROR record's gate field against subsequent same-gate PASS verdicts

Raw chronological scan of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json event files per ticket (sorted by ns-epoch filename prefix) reads data.schema and data.verdict to distinguish plan_review_result_v2, completion_verifier_pass_v1/_fail_v1, and gate_error_v1 records
